scripts.sandbox:inspect: docker compose -f sandbox/compose.yaml run --rm sandbox plugins inspect hippoclaw-memory --runtime --json
scripts.sandbox:up:stub: docker compose -f sandbox/compose.yaml --profile stub up -d stub
scripts.sandbox:up:ollama: docker compose -f sandbox/compose.yaml --profile ollama up -d --wait ollama && docker compose -f sandbox/compose.yaml --profile ollama run --rm ollama-init
scripts.sandbox:exec: docker compose -f sandbox/compose.yaml --profile stub up -d stub && docker compose -f sandbox/compose.yaml run --rm sandbox agent exec --config /home/node/sandbox/openclaw.json5 --cwd /home/node/workspace --json
scripts.sandbox:exec:ollama: HIPPOCLAW_MODEL=ollama/gemma4:e2b-dev docker compose -f sandbox/compose.yaml --profile ollama run --rm sandbox agent exec --config /home/node/sandbox/openclaw.json5 --cwd /home/node/workspace --json
scripts.sandbox:down: docker compose -f sandbox/compose.yaml --profile stub --profile ollama --profile gateway down
scripts.sandbox:gateway:up: docker compose -f sandbox/compose.yaml --profile ollama --profile gateway up -d --wait ollama gateway
scripts.sandbox:gateway:restart: docker compose -f sandbox/compose.yaml --profile gateway restart gateway
scripts.sandbox:chat: docker compose -f sandbox/compose.yaml --profile gateway exec gateway openclaw agent --session-key agent:main:direct:sandbox --json --message
